title.narrative: Adaptation investment pipeline for Fiji

description.narrative: PAF23-Q1-9 opportunity through NDC Partnership building on work carried out by CFAN and ongoing and future GCF readiness.There are three main outputs to increase the adaptation investment pipeline for Fiji1. Bolster capacity within the government to develop and manage pipelines of bankable adaptation projects (includes support to become accredited with Adaptation Fund.2. Streamline climate project portfolio information management;3. Provide outreach support to potential donors and financing institutions for the adaptation; investment plan and project concept notes developed (2 for Adaptation Fund)
